color.note: Three scene themes over a live 3D backdrop. Mars is the primary theme; Orbit and Earth change only the glass tint, the backdrop and the cool or warm bias of the neutrals. Signal colours (live, ok, warn, risk) stay the same in every scene so viewers learn them once.

tokens.name: scene-sky
tokens.usage: Stand-in for the 3D backdrop in previews and loading screens: upper part of the frame. In the app the real scene sits here.

tokens.name: scene-ground
tokens.usage: Stand-in for the 3D backdrop: lower part of the frame, and the page background behind the video frame.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fill of every floating panel, callout and the timeline dock, always with blur-glass behind it.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdowns and the settings sheet, where text must stay readable over busy parts of the scene.

tokens.name: glass-raised
tokens.usage: Inner wells inside a panel: a nested metric tile, a hovered row, an inactive icon button.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border of panels, chips and buttons. Panels have no drop shadow without this edge.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dashed guide lines and leader lines drawn over the scene, chart grid lines, dividers inside panels.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on glass, glass-strong and glass-raised in every scene.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units and secondary text on glass and glass-strong (at least 4.5:1 there).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Chart ticks, axis numbers and inactive step times only. Not for anything a viewer must read to follow the video.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The one bright accent: the active nav button, the current timeline step, the next milestone, the newest data point. One live element per view. Text on it is on-live.

tokens.name: on-live
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a live fill.

tokens.name: live-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the active timeline step and the selected segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status text 'Stable', 'Online', 'Low'; on ok-soft or glass.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of an ok status chip.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status text 'Watch', 'Dust rising'; on warn-soft or glass.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a warn status chip.

tokens.name: risk
tokens.usage: Status text 'Critical', 'Storm', terrain peaks in maps; on risk-soft or glass. Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: risk-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a risk status chip.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Colony markings: the colonist counter's unit line, rocket flame in icons, the slider fill. Brand colour of Red Station One, used in small doses.

tokens.name: cool
tokens.usage: Ships in transit, orbit paths, the Earth-to-Mars line, transfer callouts. The counterpart to rust.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with 2px offset on every interactive element. At least 3:1 on every glass in every scene.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Scene or view title, one per screen, top left. Thin weight is the signature of the system.

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: The colonist counter and other hero numbers. Unit set in metric-unit beside it.

styles.name: metric-lg
styles.usage: Main value of a metric panel.

styles.name: metric-md
styles.usage: Values in the corner readouts, callouts and inside compact panels.

styles.name: metric-unit
styles.usage: Unit after a metric: %, km, m/s, kW. Same colour as the number, smaller and never bold.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Callout text, list rows, settings labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Label above or beside a metric, in ink-muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase tag above a title or inside the brand line. Only place for uppercase besides the wordmark.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Channel wordmark in the top-left corner, uppercase, wide tracking.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Coordinates, T-minus times, ship names, sol counter, axis numbers.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Times under timeline steps and chart ticks.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between number and unit, inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between label and value, icon and text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between panels in a column; chip and button padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; inset of the HUD from the frame edge on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding on large panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Inset of the HUD from the frame edge at 1080p and up.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the title block and the first panel column.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Nested wells inside a panel, inputs, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Callouts and compact panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Standard panels and the timeline dock.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, segmented controls, the nav cluster, round icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Every glass panel: a soft drop plus a faint top highlight that reads as a glass edge.

tokens.name: shadow-live
tokens.usage: Glow on the single live element (active nav button, current step marker).

effects.note: Backdrop filter values. Every glass surface blurs and slightly saturates the scene behind it.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of panels, callouts, dock, chips.

tokens.name: blur-strong
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of menus and the settings sheet.

duration.note: Durations as plain values; easing is a gentle ease-out. Respect prefers-reduced-motion by switching all of these to 0.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press on buttons and chips.

tokens.name: dur-panel
tokens.usage: Panels sliding or fading in.

tokens.name: dur-count
tokens.usage: Numbers counting up to a new value.
